Plot enrollment composition as an alluvial (Sankey) diagram

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
plot_enrollment_sankey.Rd

Visualizes how the composition of the tested population shifts across years for one subgroup variable. Requires the ggalluvial package.

Usage

plot_enrollment_sankey(
  transition_table,
  subgroup_var,
  years = NULL,
  assessment_spec,
  palette = NULL
)

Arguments

transition_table

A data frame — the $table element returned by compute_subgroup_transitions(). Must contain columns YEAR, subgroup_val, N, and suppressed.

subgroup_var

Character scalar. The demographic variable being plotted (used for axis labels and the plot title).

years

Integer vector of years to include. NULL includes all years present in transition_table. Default NULL.

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

palette

Named character vector of colors, keyed by subgroup_val. NULL uses ggplot2::scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2"). Default NULL.

Value

A ggplot2 object (ggalluvial layers). Returns an informative blank plot if all data is suppressed or if ggalluvial is not installed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
trans <- compute_subgroup_transitions(demo_data, "RACE_ETHNICITY", assessment_spec)
plot_enrollment_sankey(trans$table, "RACE_ETHNICITY", assessment_spec = assessment_spec)
} # }
